skills.description: Add or change a doctrina CLI command or subcommand without leaving any surface (help, hub, docs, tests) behind.
Cut a doctrina-cli release with consistent version stamps, a Changelog entry, and every gate green.
Keep docs/en and docs/pt as true mirrors — same files, same structure, EN as the source of truth.
Two-source cross-checks must exempt entries that one source records by design and the other deletes — an abandoned change is ledger-only, never archived
Edit files under .doctrina/ knowing they are CRLF, so a regex or script patch cannot silently match nothing and report success.
Split a capability spec that crossed the 400-line cap into two coherent capabilities without losing provenance.
Open several changes as a planned-but-not-started backlog that still passes analyze, without the context pack overflowing its budget.
Recognise when the lane classifier holds an authoring task as RUNTIME because of its nouns, and decide between --force, --chore and an actual diagnosis.
Write acceptance criteria whose evidence actually resolves, so coverage --strict stays green and honest.
